<thought>I need to determine how many aromatic carbons are present in the unknown sample. The most direct way is to obtain its 13C NMR spectrum and count the signals that fall in the typical aromatic region (≈110–160 ppm). This will give the number of distinct aromatic carbon environments, which corresponds to the number of aromatic carbons in the molecule (assuming no symmetry that makes equivalent carbons give a single signal). I will request the 13C NMR spectrum for the sample.</thought>
